ja.business: 営業、顧客対応、販売促進、データ分析をクラウドで管理し、AIエージェントも業務へ組み込む会社。
ja.revenue: Sales、Service、Data Cloud、Slackなどの利用契約とサポートが中心。導入支援や研修からも収入を得る。
ja.strength: 顧客情報を共通基盤へ集め、営業や問い合わせ対応の流れとAIを同じ権限・データ管理の下で動かせる。
ja.risks: 企業のIT予算と契約更新に左右され、生成AIの品質・費用・個人情報管理が導入速度を決める。製品統合が複雑になるリスクもある。
ja.competition: 営業CRMではMicrosoft Dynamics 365 Sales、Oracle CX、SAP Sales Cloud V2、HubSpot Sales Hub、顧客データ・マーケティングではAdobe Experience Platformが比較例。Salesforceの年次報告と各社の公式製品を照合した編集上の比較で、Salesforce自身が全社を実名列挙したという意味ではない。Pegasystemsの顧客対応・業務自動化は同社の年次報告による実名開示。 顧客対応ではServiceNow Customer Service ManagementとSalesforceのケース管理を公式製品で編集比較する。営業CRM、IT運用管理、全AI基盤を一括で同等とはしない。
ja.relationships: Anthropicとは2026年8月にClaudeforceを発表し、ClaudeからSalesforceのデータ・業務操作を扱う連携を説明した。OpenAIとは2025年10月にAgentforce・ChatGPT・Slackの連携拡大を発表。公表済み機能と今後の統合計画を分けて捉える。 Amazon / AWS：2026年9月15日：AWSとSalesforceのデータ・AI連携を拡大。Quick、Slack、Bedrock、Data 360等を接続し、一部音声機能等は秋の提供計画 Alphabet / Google Cloud：2026年9月15日：Google CloudとGemini・Agentforce、データ接続を共同展開。Hyperforceの北米一般提供は11月予定 Alphabet / Google Cloud：Salesforce自社の9月説明でHyperforceのGoogle Cloud本番利用を確認。米国の一部顧客移行と北米一般提供は別途予定 Amazon / AWS：Salesforce公式説明でAWS上のHyperforce・Bedrock利用を確認。Agentforceの一部機能の発表予定と基盤利用を区別 CrowdStrike：Salesforce自社の2025年12月事例：CrowdStrikeがAWS Bedrock上のAgentforceを利用。受注額や全社の統一採用は不明

en.business: Provides cloud software for sales, service, marketing and analytics and embeds AI agents into business workflows.
en.revenue: Subscriptions and support for Sales, Service, Data Cloud, Slack and other products lead revenue, with services and training also contributing.
en.strength: Unifies customer data, workflows and AI under shared permissions and governance across front-office teams.
en.risks: Enterprise budgets and renewals matter, while generative-AI quality, cost and privacy can slow adoption and product integration can add complexity.
en.competition: Sales-CRM comparisons cover Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Oracle CX, SAP Sales Cloud V2 and HubSpot Sales Hub; Adobe Experience Platform overlaps in customer data/marketing. These editorial comparisons use Salesforce’s filing and official products, not a claim that Salesforce explicitly lists every company. Pegasystems independently names Salesforce in customer engagement/workflow automation. Customer service adds an editorial comparison with ServiceNow Customer Service Management in case handling using official products. Sales CRM, IT operations and entire AI platforms are not equated.
en.relationships: Salesforce announced Claudeforce with Anthropic in August 2026, connecting Claude with Salesforce data and governed business actions. An October 2025 OpenAI announcement expanded Agentforce, ChatGPT and Slack integration. Announced available features are distinct from further integration plans. Amazon / AWS: September 15, 2026: expands AWS collaboration across Quick, Slack, Bedrock and Data 360; some voice features and agents remain fall availability plans Alphabet / Google Cloud: September 15, 2026: Google Cloud alliance covers Gemini, Agentforce and data integration; North America Hyperforce GA is planned for November Alphabet / Google Cloud: Salesforce’s September disclosure confirms Hyperforce production traffic on Google Cloud; selected US migrations and North America GA remain separately planned Amazon / AWS: Salesforce identifies Hyperforce / Bedrock use on AWS; cloud adoption is distinguished from planned availability of individual Agentforce features CrowdStrike: Salesforce’s December 2025 example identifies CrowdStrike using Agentforce with Amazon Bedrock; no contract value or all-company standardization asserted

ja.strength: 部署や既存システムをまたぐ作業手順を共通データへつなぎ、AIを使った受付、判断、実行まで一体化できる。

en.revenue: Software subscriptions and support, consulting and systems work, mainframes and servers, and related financing generate revenue.
en.strength: Deep mission-critical customer relationships and Red Hat technology support operations spanning on-premises systems and multiple clouds.
en.risks: Cloud and AI competition makes portfolio execution critical; large projects, skilled labor, currency and cyber incidents also affect results.

ja.business: 電圧や温度など現実世界の信号を扱うアナログ半導体と、機器を制御する組み込みプロセッサを設計・製造する会社。
ja.revenue: 2025年売上の約79％がアナログ、約15％が組み込み処理。産業・自動車向けがそれぞれ約33％を占める。
ja.strength: 8万点超の幅広い製品、自社製造、10万社超の顧客網、長寿命製品を組み合わせ、少量多品種の需要にも対応できる。
ja.risks: 半導体の在庫循環で需要が振れやすい。大規模な工場投資は需要不足時に稼働率と利益率を圧迫し、アジア勢との価格競争も強まる。
ja.competition: アナログ・組み込み半導体ではNXPが競合例。NXPの年次報告書は同社を主要競合の一社として挙げる一方、競争は製品群の一部で生じると説明している。採用用途や性能、供給、価格などで比較する。
ja.relationships: 2026年3月にNVIDIAとの協業を発表し、TIのミリ波レーダーをJetson Thor・Holoscanへ接続するロボット向け技術を説明した。センシング・制御・電源と演算基盤の連携で、NVIDIAのGPUをTIが製造する契約ではない。

en.business: Designs and manufactures analog chips that handle real-world signals and embedded processors that control electronic equipment.
en.revenue: Analog generated about 79% and Embedded Processing about 15% of 2025 revenue; industrial and automotive each contributed about 33%.
en.strength: Combines more than 80,000 products, internal manufacturing, over 100,000 customers and long product lives to serve diverse designs.
en.risks: Inventory cycles can swing demand; large fab investments pressure utilization and margins in downturns, while Asian price competition is increasing.
en.competition: NXP names this company among its semiconductor rivals and states that competition applies to some, rather than all, product lines. The relevant comparison is analog and embedded semiconductors, with selection depending on application, performance, availability and cost.
en.relationships: A March 2026 NVIDIA collaboration connects TI mmWave radar with Jetson Thor and Holoscan for robotics. It joins sensing, control and power with compute technology; it is not a contract for TI to manufacture NVIDIA GPUs.

ja.business: 電力を効率よく変換・制御する高集積の電源管理半導体を設計し、データセンターや車、産業機器へ提供する会社。
ja.revenue: ストレージ・コンピューティング、企業データ、車載、産業、通信、民生向けに半導体を販売する。
ja.strength: 小型・高集積・低消費電力の設計と、顧客の回路設計を支援する技術者を組み合わせ、電源回路全体を提案できる。
ja.risks: 外部のウエハー製造・組立会社へ依存する。2025年は上位3代理店だけで売上の54％を占め、需要予測や在庫のずれが大きくなりやすい。
ja.competition: MPS自身はAnalog Devices・Infineon・NXP・onsemi・Texas Instrumentsなどを競合に挙げる。電源管理・混載半導体の比較で、公式製品ではNXPのPMIC、Infineonの電源ICが例。電圧変換、制御、電力段は役割が異なり、CPU・GPUやNANDメモリー自体との比較ではない。
ja.relationships: データセンター、車載、産業機器メーカーへ電源管理製品を供給し、販売代理店を通じて幅広い顧客へ届ける。 2026年9月9日、GlobalFoundriesと長期製造契約を発表。MPS独自プロセスをシンガポールの300mm工場へ導入し、2027年初めに電源管理半導体の製造能力を拡張する計画。発表時点の計画であり、量産開始済み・確定数量や特定GPU企業への販売を示すものではない。

en.business: Designs highly integrated power-management chips that efficiently convert and control power in data centers, vehicles and industrial equipment.
en.revenue: Sells semiconductors into storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, industrial, communications and consumer markets.
en.strength: Combines compact, highly integrated and efficient designs with application engineers who help customers optimize complete power systems.
en.risks: Relies on outside wafer fabs and assembly; its top three distributors represented 54% of 2025 revenue, increasing forecast and inventory exposure.
en.competition: MPS names Analog Devices, Infineon, NXP, onsemi and Texas Instruments among its competitors. The comparison concerns power-management and mixed-signal chips, with official examples including NXP PMICs and Infineon power-supply ICs. Conversion, control and power stages differ; these are not CPU/GPU or NAND-memory comparisons.
en.relationships: Supplies power-management products to data-center, automotive and industrial equipment makers through a distributor-heavy channel. On September 9, 2026 MPS and GlobalFoundries announced a long-term manufacturing agreement to deploy MPS processes at GF’s Singapore 300mm fab, with capacity expansion planned for early 2027. This does not establish completed volume production, a committed quantity or sales to a particular GPU company.

ja.strength: シリコン、SiC、GaNの電力変換と車載画像センサーを持ち、設計から製造・パッケージまで一体で最適化できる。

ja.relationships: NIOの2026年4月のEliteSiC採用に加え、BMW AGとは2023年3月、Volkswagen AGとは2024年7月にEV駆動系向けSiCの供給契約を発表した。NVIDIAとは2025年7月にAIデータセンターの800VDC電源技術で協業を発表。発表時点の用途・契約範囲を示し、全車種への供給や現在の調達量、出資を意味しない。 GlobalFoundriesとは2025年12月に650V GaNの開発・製造協業契約を発表した。2026年前半のサンプル予定から量産完了や現在の供給量を推定しない。Synaptics買収契約は2026年10月に現金123ドル/株へ改定され、2027年半ば予定・承認条件付きで未完了。

en.business: Makes power semiconductors for EVs, renewable energy and AI data centers and image sensors for vehicles and factories.

en.strength: Combines silicon, SiC and GaN power conversion with automotive imaging and integrates design, manufacturing and packaging.
en.risks: Automotive and industrial demand, SiC fab utilization and distributor inventory matter; 2025 also included sizable manufacturing realignment and inventory charges.
en.competition: Competes with Infineon and STMicroelectronics in power, Texas Instruments and Analog Devices in analog, and Sony and Samsung in imaging.
en.relationships: Alongside NIO’s April 2026 EliteSiC adoption, onsemi announced EV-drivetrain SiC supply agreements with BMW AG in March 2023 and Volkswagen AG in July 2024. A July 2025 NVIDIA collaboration concerns 800 VDC power technology for AI data centers. These dated scopes do not establish all-model supply, current purchase volumes or equity investment. A December2025 GlobalFoundries agreement covers 650V GaN development and manufacturing; the announced H1-2026 sampling schedule does not prove completed volume production or current quantities. The Synaptics agreement was amended in October2026 to $123/share cash, with a conditional mid-2027 closing target, not completed ownership.

ja.risks: SanDisk分離後はHDDへの集中が高い。2026年度は上位3顧客が売上の44％を占め、クラウド投資、価格、技術移行の影響が大きい。

ja.relationships: クラウド事業者と機器メーカーへ大容量HDDを供給し、長期保存や大規模データ基盤を支える。 Microsoftとの使用済みHDDの希土類回収プログラムを2026年4月に公表。回収実証の協力であり、この発表だけでMicrosoftへのHDD供給量や購入契約を確定しない。

en.business: Develops and manufactures hard disk drives that store large data volumes for cloud, enterprise, PC and surveillance systems.
en.revenue: Sells HDDs to hyperscale cloud providers, neoclouds, computer makers, OEMs, distributors and retailers.
en.strength: Designs and manufactures substantially all recording heads and magnetic media, supporting continued gains in capacity and cost per drive.
en.risks: After the SanDisk separation it is concentrated in HDDs; its top three customers were 44% of fiscal 2026 revenue, increasing cloud-spending, pricing and transition risk.
en.competition: HDD examples retain Seagate Technology and Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage. Editorial alternative-storage examples are Micron and Samsung enterprise/data-center SSDs. Official products support the SSD comparison; HDDs and SSDs often complement one another and compete in selected workloads, with different capacity, performance and cost trade-offs.
en.relationships: Supplies high-capacity HDDs to cloud operators and equipment makers for mass data infrastructure and long-term storage. An April 2026 disclosure names Microsoft in a retired-HDD rare-earth recovery program. This pilot collaboration alone does not establish Microsoft HDD supply volumes or a purchase contract.

ja.competition: EDAではSynopsysとSiemens EDA、物理解析ではSynopsys傘下AnsysやKeysightが競合例。いずれもCadenceが実名で挙げる企業・製品分野に基づく。チップの設計・検証、基板設計、電磁界・物理解析では用途が異なる。顧客の社内設計ツールも代替手段であり、設計IPや技術サービスの競争は製品ごとに異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体・電子機器会社へ設計ソフト、検証装置、IPを提供し、顧客の新しいチップやシステム開発を支える。 TSMCとは2026年9月にA14・N2Pの認証設計フロー、3D-IC・IPで協業を拡大。個別IPの開発・評価中の工程と認証済みツールを区別し、全IPの提供完了とは扱わない。

en.business: Provides EDA software, prototyping hardware, design IP and physics simulation for semiconductor and electronic-system design and verification.
en.revenue: Primarily earns recurring revenue from two-to-three-year licenses, maintenance, design IP, verification hardware and technical services.
en.strength: Covers chips, packages, boards and systems in connected workflows and uses AI to automate design exploration and verification.
en.risks: Semiconductor R&D budgets, export controls and large renewal timing affect results; customers can also develop competing internal tools.
en.competition: Synopsys and Siemens EDA in electronic design, plus Synopsys-owned Ansys and Keysight in physical/electronic analysis, are examples grounded in Cadence named-vendor disclosure. Chip design/verification, board design and physics analysis serve different workloads. Customer-built tools remain alternatives; design-IP and engineering-service rivalry varies by product.
en.relationships: Supplies design software, verification hardware and IP to semiconductor and electronics companies developing new chips and systems. A September 2026 TSMC collaboration expands certified A14 / N2P flows, 3D-IC and IP. Certified tools and IP still in development or testing have different availability; not all IP is complete.

en.revenue: Earns from electronic instruments and test systems, design and simulation software, calibration, repair and engineering services.
en.strength: Combines more than 80 years of measurement expertise and a large installed base with tools spanning design, simulation, prototype and production test.
en.risks: Results depend on customer R&D and capital spending and face China restrictions, component supply, acquisition integration and technology-transition risks.
en.competition: Examples include Teradyne in product test, Rohde & Schwarz in oscilloscopes, VIAVI in network test and monitoring, and Cadence in RF circuit and electromagnetic design. Teradyne and VIAVI name Keysight; Rohde is supported by Keysight’s comparison and Cadence by an editorial comparison of disclosed products.
en.relationships: Supplies measurement and design and test software to communications, semiconductor, automotive, battery, aerospace and defense developers. A March 2025 Broadcom collaboration addresses signal integrity and error correction for 1.6T network testing. Development / validation collaboration does not disclose purchase volumes or exclusivity.

ja.business: 顧客企業に代わって電子機器やデータセンター向け電源・冷却設備を設計、調達、製造する会社。

ja.strength: 世界各地の工場、調達網、設計力を組み合わせ、部品調達から量産、修理まで一括で請け負える。

ja.relationships: 通信、クラウド・データセンター、自動車、医療、産業機器会社の製品と電源設備を設計・製造する。 NVIDIAとは2026年3月にOmniverse DSX向けの電源・液冷・ラック統合設計を発表。800VDC移行を支える設計であり、全計画設備の稼働完了を意味しない。

ja.business: 企業ネットワークを守るファイアウォール、SASE、クラウド・端末・運用監視のセキュリティ製品を提供する会社。
ja.revenue: FortiGateなどの機器・ソフト販売と、FortiGuardのセキュリティ購読、FortiCare保守、クラウドサービスから稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 独自ASICを使う機器と多数のセキュリティ機能を同じOSで統合し、拠点・クラウド・端末を一括管理できる。
ja.risks: 機器更新の波、競合の値下げ・無料バンドル、製品の脆弱性、契約更新、クラウド運用費の増加が業績に影響する。
ja.competition: Fortinet自身が挙げるCisco・Palo Alto Networks・CrowdStrike・Microsoft・Zscalerを公式製品と照合した。FortiGateはファイアウォール、FortiEDRは端末保護、Zscaler Internet Accessはクラウド経由の安全な接続の比較例。ネットワーク、端末、クラウド接続では用途が異なり、各社の全製品が同等という意味ではない。
ja.relationships: 企業、通信事業者、公共機関へ、販売代理店やサービス事業者を通じて機器と継続課金の防御サービスを提供する。 Google Cloudとは2026年4月の自社発表で、クラウドのワークロード防御の共同開発・共同販売を確認。FortiCNAPP等の製品連携であり、Googleへの出資や計算容量の購入契約ではない。

en.business: Provides firewalls, SASE and cloud, endpoint and security-operations products that protect enterprise networks.
en.revenue: Earns from FortiGate and other hardware and software, FortiGuard security subscriptions, FortiCare support and cloud services.
en.strength: Combines proprietary-ASIC appliances and many security functions under one operating system to manage branches, cloud and endpoints together.
en.risks: Hardware refresh cycles, competitor discounting and bundling, vulnerabilities, renewals and rising cloud-delivery costs can affect results.
en.competition: Fortinet names Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Microsoft and Zscaler. Official-product matching separates FortiGate firewalls, FortiEDR endpoint protection and Zscaler Internet Access cloud-delivered secure access. Network, endpoint and cloud-access use cases differ; entire portfolios are not equivalent.
en.relationships: Sells appliances and recurring protection services to enterprises, carriers and public organizations through distributors and service providers. An April 2026 disclosure confirms joint Google Cloud workload-security development and co-selling, including FortiCNAPP integration. This is not an equity investment in Google or a compute-capacity purchase contract.

ja.business: 社内ネットワークへ直接つながず、利用者・端末・クラウドアプリごとに通信を検証するゼロトラスト型セキュリティ会社。
ja.revenue: クラウド防御基盤へのアクセスを、利用者数や通信量に応じた1〜5年のサブスクリプションで販売する。
ja.strength: 世界中のクラウド拠点で通信を検査し、Web、SaaS、社内アプリ、データ、AI利用を一つの基盤で守れる。
ja.risks: 大口契約の営業期間が長く、競合の無料バンドル、クラウド障害、脅威の見逃し、更新率低下が成長に響く。
ja.competition: クラウド型の安全な接続・通信防御ではPalo Alto NetworksとFortinetが競合例。両社の年次報告はZscalerを実名で競合として挙げている。SASEなどの接続・防御機能で比べるもので、端末防御など全製品が同じという意味ではない。
ja.relationships: Microsoft Entra Agent IDの早期導入パートナーとして2025年11月に参加を発表。CrowdStrikeとは2026年9月にゼロトラストとセキュリティ運用の連携を拡大した。OpenAIとは2026年4月にTACプログラム参加と防御AI利用を説明している。開発中の連携や追加導入計画は、提供済み機能と区別する。

en.business: Provides zero-trust security that verifies each user, device and application connection instead of placing users directly on corporate networks.
en.revenue: Sells one-to-five-year subscriptions to its cloud security platform, generally priced by users and metered usage.
en.strength: Inspects traffic across a global cloud and protects web, SaaS, private applications, data and AI use on one platform.
en.risks: Long enterprise sales cycles, competitor bundling, cloud outages, missed threats and lower renewal rates can weaken growth.
en.competition: Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet are examples in cloud-delivered secure access and traffic protection. Both name Zscaler in their annual reports. The overlap includes secure networking and SASE capabilities rather than every endpoint or security product.
en.relationships: Zscaler joined the Microsoft Entra Agent ID early-adoption ecosystem in November 2025, expanded its CrowdStrike Zero Trust/SecOps partnership in September 2026, and described OpenAI TAC participation and defensive-AI use in April 2026. Integrations under development and further adoption plans remain distinct from delivered functionality.

ja.business: 世界各地のネットワークを使い、Webサイトやアプリを高速化し、攻撃から守り、企業の通信や開発処理も動かす会社。
ja.revenue: CDN、DDoS防御、ゼロトラスト、開発者向け計算基盤などを、無料枠から大企業向け契約までサブスク中心で販売する。
ja.strength: 同じ世界ネットワーク上で配信、セキュリティ、接続、サーバーレス計算をまとめて提供し、通信データを製品改善へ活かせる。
ja.risks: ネットワーク障害や攻撃、設備投資負担、通信・データ規制、価格競争があり、2025年も最終赤字だった。
ja.competition: CDNではAkamai、ゼロトラスト接続ではZscaler、サーバーレス計算ではAWSのLambdaなどが競合例。Cloudflare自身が製品別の比較を公開している。比較資料は競合分野の確認に使い、性能や価格の優劣をそのまま断定しない。
ja.relationships: 2026年7月にOpenAIとの研究パイロットを発表。参加Webサイトの更新・トラフィックなどのネットワーク情報を活用し、AI検索の探索・索引精度を改善する研究。全顧客のコンテンツ提供契約や独占提携、研究成果の実現を意味しない。

en.business: Runs a global network that accelerates and protects websites and applications and also carries enterprise traffic and developer workloads.
en.revenue: Sells CDN, DDoS protection, zero-trust and developer-compute products mainly through subscriptions from free plans to enterprise contracts.
en.strength: Delivers content, security, connectivity and serverless compute on one global network and uses traffic insight to improve products.
en.risks: Network outages, attacks, infrastructure spending, communications and data regulation and pricing pressure remain risks; it was still loss-making in 2025.
en.competition: Examples include Akamai in CDN, Zscaler in zero-trust access, and AWS Lambda in serverless compute. Cloudflare publishes product-specific comparisons. These identify overlapping products without adopting the vendor’s performance or pricing superiority claims.
en.relationships: A July 2026 OpenAI research pilot examines whether network signals from participating websites improve AI-search discovery and indexing. It is a research collaboration, not an exclusive content deal covering every Cloudflare customer or a guarantee of achieved results.

ja.relationships: 2025年10月のAdobe MAXでは、FireflyでGoogleとOpenAIの生成AIモデルを選択・利用できる機能を公表した。これは制作ツールへのモデル連携で、両社がAdobeの計算容量を購入する契約ではない。製品・機能ごとに提供範囲が異なる。 Adobe公式の2026年5月1日更新ページは、NemetschekグループのMaxonとSubstance 3D/Maxon Oneをセットで提供する提携を説明している。更新日は契約締結日ではなく、出資・独占・売上金額は示さない。 NVIDIAとは2026年3月にFirefly・Omniverse等の戦略協業方針を公表したが、合意は非拘束で全開発完了を示さない。Walmartの2026年公式事例はFireflyによる制作業務を紹介する。一方、2021年発表のWalmart Store Fulfillment拡張・Marketplace統合は2024年2月に終了しており、現在の提供機能としない。Semrushは2026年4月28日に取得完了したAdobeの事業で、独立した現行上場の提携先ではない。

en.business: Provides Creative Cloud for images and video, Document Cloud for PDF and enterprise customer-experience and marketing software. Its search and brand-visibility business includes Semrush, acquired in April2026.
en.revenue: Earns from individual and enterprise subscriptions to products such as Photoshop, Illustrator and Acrobat and from enterprise data and marketing services.
en.strength: Combines standard creative tools, the PDF ecosystem, end-to-end enterprise content workflows and commercially safer generative AI.
en.risks: Generative AI and free tools, renewals, pricing resistance, copyright and training-data rules and talent competition can weaken results.
en.competition: Official-product comparisons cover Apple Final Cut Pro versus Premiere Pro, Microsoft Clipchamp versus Adobe Express video creation, and Salesforce versus Adobe Experience Platform in customer data/marketing. Docusign e-signatures and Klaviyo marketing are separately supported by those peers’ filings naming Adobe.
en.relationships: Adobe MAX in October 2025 described Google and OpenAI model options in Firefly. These are creative-tool model integrations, not contracts for those companies to buy Adobe compute capacity. Availability differs by product and feature. Adobe’s page updated May 1, 2026 describes a Substance 3D / Maxon One bundle partnership with Maxon in the Nemetschek group. The update date is not a contract signing date; no equity investment, exclusivity or revenue amount is inferred. A March2026 NVIDIA announcement sets out a non-binding Firefly / Omniverse collaboration, not completion of all development. Adobe’s 2026 Walmart example describes Firefly creative operations. The older Walmart Store Fulfillment extension and Marketplace integration ended in February2024 and are not current services. Semrush was acquired on April28,2026 and is an Adobe business, not an independently listed current partner.

ja.business: 中小企業向けQuickBooks、個人の確定申告TurboTax、金融比較Credit Karma、営業支援Mailchimpを提供する会社。
ja.revenue: 会計・給与・税務ソフトのサブスク、決済手数料、融資、確定申告支援、金融商品の送客、マーケティングサービスから稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 会計、給与、決済、税務、融資を同じ顧客データでつなぎ、専門家支援とAIを組み合わせられる。
ja.risks: 無料の税務・会計サービス、政府の直接申告、税制変更、信用・決済損失、重要な税務シーズンの障害が業績に影響する。
ja.competition: 税務申告ではTurboTaxとH&R Block、請求書決済ではQuickBooksとBILL、メール販促・自動化ではMailchimpとHubSpotが競合例。税務は公表製品の比較、BILLは相手側の開示、HubSpotはMailchimp自身の比較資料が根拠。製品分野を分けて見る。 米国の小規模企業向け給与計算ではQuickBooks WorkforceとRUN Powered by ADPを両社の公式比較資料で照合する。国別条件、料金、全HCM機能が同じという意味ではない。 個人金融では、Credit KarmaとExperianの米国向け無料信用スコア閲覧を公式サービスで編集比較する。Credit KarmaはTransUnion/EquifaxのVantageScore 3.0、ExperianはExperianデータに基づくFICO Score 8で、スコア方式は異なる。上場親会社はロンドン上場のExperian plc（EXPN）。
ja.relationships: OpenAI・AnthropicとAIモデル利用やChatGPT・Claudeでの金融ツール連携を進める。Anthropicとの2026年2月発表にはClaude Agent SDKによる業務エージェント、MCP連携、Claude Code採用を含む。段階展開の計画と提供済み機能を区別し、両社との売上分配や全体展開完了を推定しない。

en.business: Provides QuickBooks for small businesses, TurboTax for tax filing, Credit Karma for consumer finance and Mailchimp for marketing.
en.revenue: Earns from accounting, payroll and tax subscriptions, payments, lending, assisted tax, financial-product referrals and marketing services.
en.strength: Connects accounting, payroll, payments, tax and lending on shared customer data and combines software with experts and AI.
en.risks: Free tax and accounting tools, government direct filing, tax-law changes, credit and payment losses and peak-season outages can affect results.
en.competition: Examples include H&R Block versus TurboTax in tax preparation, BILL versus QuickBooks bill payment, and HubSpot versus Mailchimp in email marketing and automation. Tax is a disclosed-product comparison, BILL is peer-side disclosure, and Mailchimp publishes its own HubSpot comparison. These are separate product markets. US small-business payroll compares QuickBooks Workforce with RUN Powered by ADP using both companies’ official comparisons. Country terms, pricing and the full HCM portfolios are not equated. Consumer finance adds an editorial comparison of US free credit-score access from Credit Karma and Experian. Credit Karma uses TransUnion/Equifax VantageScore 3.0, while Experian offers FICO Score 8 based on Experian data; these are different scoring models. The listed parent is Experian plc, London Stock Exchange EXPN.
en.relationships: Intuit works with OpenAI and Anthropic on model use and financial-tool integration in ChatGPT and Claude. Its February 2026 Anthropic announcement includes Claude Agent SDK workflows, MCP integrations and Claude Code adoption. Phased rollout plans do not establish completed delivery of all features or revenue-sharing arrangements.

ja.business: 世界各地のエッジ網を使い、Web配信の高速化、サイバー防御、クラウド計算基盤を企業へ提供する会社。
ja.revenue: セキュリティ、配信、クラウド計算の利用料や契約料金が中心で、大企業やメディア、SaaS事業者から継続収入を得る。
ja.strength: 利用者に近い多数の拠点と大量通信を処理する運用技術を持ち、配信と防御を同じ基盤で提供できる。
ja.risks: 大手クラウドやCDNとの競争、通信量単価の低下、障害や攻撃、設備投資、通信・データセンター費の上昇が重荷になる。
ja.competition: CDNではCloudflareとAWSのCloudFront、クラウド計算ではAWSのEC2、Web・API防御ではF5が競合例。CloudflareとF5はAkamaiを名指しした製品比較を公開。AWSは公表製品を比較したもので、各社の性能・価格の優劣を断定するものではない。
ja.relationships: 通信・データセンター事業者の設備を使い、企業やメディアのコンテンツとアプリを利用者の近くで配信・防御する。 2026年9月、Anthropic向けCPUクラウド容量の7年116億ドルの契約コミットメントを発表。将来の提供条件付きで売上実績ではなく、追加拡張分や最大約5%の条件付きワラントを全取得済みとは扱わない。3月にはNVIDIA Blackwell GPUの取得・展開を発表しており、CPU顧客契約とは異なる役割。

en.business: Uses a global edge network to accelerate web delivery, protect applications and provide cloud computing services to enterprises.
en.revenue: Earns recurring and usage-based fees from security, delivery and compute services sold to enterprises, media companies and software providers.
en.strength: Combines a widely distributed edge footprint with operating expertise that can deliver and secure high volumes of traffic on one platform.
en.risks: Cloud and CDN competition, falling delivery prices, outages, attacks, capital needs and higher network or colocation costs can pressure results.
en.competition: Examples include Cloudflare and AWS CloudFront in CDN, AWS EC2 in cloud compute, and F5 in web and API protection. Cloudflare and F5 publish comparisons naming Akamai; AWS is an editorial comparison of disclosed products. Vendor superiority claims are not adopted.
en.relationships: Uses carrier and data-center infrastructure to deliver and protect enterprise, media and software traffic close to end users. In September 2026 it announced a seven-year $11.6bn Anthropic CPU-cloud commitment, subject to delivery terms rather than realized revenue. Expansion options and warrants for up to about 5% are not treated as exercised ownership. Its March NVIDIA Blackwell acquisition / deployment announcement has a separate supplier role.

ja.business: 従業員や顧客が本人かを確認し、許可されたクラウドや社内システムへ安全に入れるようにするID管理会社。
ja.revenue: Workforce IdentityとCustomer Identityのクラウド契約が中心で、利用者数や機能、契約期間に応じたサブスク収入を得る。
ja.strength: 特定クラウドに偏らず、多数の業務アプリや端末と接続できる統合網とID専業の運用知識が強み。
ja.risks: 自社や顧客への侵害は信用を直接損ない、大手ソフト企業との競争、長い販売期間、クラウド障害も成長を左右する。
ja.competition: Microsoft Entra IDは従業員向け認証の製品例で、MicrosoftはOkta自身が主要競合と明記する。Ping Identityの従業員・顧客向け認証、SailPointのアクセス権限ガバナンス、Google Identity Platformのアプリ利用者認証は公式製品に基づく編集上の比較。Auth0の顧客認証と従業員の権限管理を分ける。社内開発やオープンソースも代替手段になる。
ja.relationships: 企業の人事・業務アプリや顧客向けサービスをつなぎ、販売・導入パートナーを通じて認証とアクセス制御を提供する。 2026年9月の自社報告はOpenAI DaybreakとAnthropic Project Glasswingのモデルを使い、自社製品の脆弱性を調査したと説明。研究プログラム・モデル利用の提携で、全顧客への機能提供や計算容量購入ではない。

en.business: Provides identity software that verifies employees and customers and controls secure access to cloud and on-premise systems.
en.revenue: Earns mainly subscription revenue from Workforce Identity and Customer Identity, priced by users, capabilities and contract terms.
en.strength: Its vendor-neutral integration network connects many business applications and devices, backed by focused identity expertise.
en.risks: A breach can directly damage trust, while large software rivals, long sales cycles and cloud outages can slow growth.
en.competition: Microsoft Entra ID is a workforce-authentication example; Okta explicitly names Microsoft as a principal competitor. Ping Identity workforce/customer authentication, SailPoint access governance and Google Identity Platform app authentication are editorial comparisons of official products. Customer authentication, including Auth0, differs from workforce governance. In-house development and open-source software remain alternatives.
en.relationships: Connects enterprise HR and business apps and customer services, delivering authentication and access controls through implementation and channel partners. Its September 2026 report describes using OpenAI Daybreak and Anthropic Project Glasswing models to investigate vulnerabilities in its own products. These are research / model-access partnerships, without implying availability to all customers or computing-capacity purchases.

ja.business: PC、サーバー、クラウド、IDを監視し、AIで攻撃を検知・封じ込めるSingularityセキュリティ基盤の会社。
ja.revenue: 保護する端末や利用機能に応じた期間契約のサブスクが中心で、企業や公的機関から継続収入を得る。
ja.strength: 端末からクラウドまでの情報を一つのデータ基盤に集め、検知後の調査と復旧を自動化できる。
ja.risks: 競争が激しく赤字が続く可能性があり、検知漏れ、侵害、AI判断の誤り、クラウド費、販売パートナー依存が負担になる。
ja.competition: SentinelOneの開示では、端末防御にCrowdStrike・Broadcom（Carbon Black／Symantec）・Trellix・Microsoft、セキュリティ基盤にPalo Alto Networks、ログを集めて脅威を検知するSIEMにCisco傘下SplunkとElastic、クラウド防御にGoogle傘下Wizを挙げる。製品分野ごとの競合で、全サービスが同一ではない。WizのGoogleによる取得完了も公式発表で確認した。
ja.relationships: 企業や政府へ直接または販売会社・運用代行会社経由で提供し、クラウドや業務ツールと連携して脅威データを集める。 2026年3月にGoogle Cloudとの複数年セキュリティ開発協業を発表。Singularityを北米・Frankfurt・サウジアラビアのGoogle Cloud地域で提供する基盤利用も記載する。開発提携とクラウド供給を分け、後続の全開発計画が完成したとは扱わない。

en.business: Provides the Singularity security platform, using AI to detect and contain attacks across endpoints, servers, cloud workloads and identities.
en.revenue: Earns recurring term-subscription revenue based mainly on protected endpoints and purchased capabilities from enterprises and public organizations.
en.strength: Brings endpoint, cloud and identity telemetry into one data platform and automates investigation, response and recovery.
en.risks: Intense competition, continued losses, missed detections, breaches, AI errors, cloud costs and reliance on channel partners can hurt results.
en.competition: SentinelOne names CrowdStrike, Broadcom’s Carbon Black/Symantec, Trellix and Microsoft in endpoint protection; Palo Alto Networks in broader security; Cisco-owned Splunk and Elastic in SIEM; and Google-owned Wiz in cloud security. These are field-specific rivals with different portfolios. Google’s official announcement independently confirms completion of the Wiz acquisition.
en.relationships: Sells directly and through resellers and managed-security providers, integrating with cloud and business tools to collect threat telemetry. A March 2026 release names multiyear Google Cloud security development and Singularity hosting across North America, Frankfurt and Saudi Arabia regions. Collaboration and infrastructure supply are separate roles; later development plans are not assumed complete.

ja.business: 企業のネットワーク、クラウド、メール、端末を守るファイアウォールと統合セキュリティ製品を開発する会社。
ja.revenue: 機器・ソフトの販売に加え、脅威防御のサブスク、更新、保守・サポートから継続収入を得る。
ja.strength: 長年蓄積した脅威情報と一元管理技術を使い、ネットワークからクラウド・端末まで共通方針で守れる。
ja.risks: クラウド移行への対応遅れ、激しい価格競争、検知漏れや脆弱性、販売会社依存、為替やイスラエル情勢が業績に影響する。
ja.competition: ネットワーク防御ではPalo Alto Networks、Fortinet、Cisco、クラウド防御ではCrowdStrike Falcon Cloud SecurityとMicrosoft Defender for Cloudが競合例。企業名はCheck Point自身の開示にあり、後者2製品は公式情報をCloudGuardの分野と照合した。ネットワーク・クラウド・端末は分けて見る。メールやモバイルなど他分野まで同一の競合構成とはしない。
ja.relationships: 販売会社やシステム構築会社を通じて企業・政府へ提供し、クラウドや端末環境を一つの管理基盤で保護する。 Microsoftとの公式提携ページはAzure、Sentinel、Intuneとのセキュリティ統合を説明。製品連携とMicrosoft製防御製品との競争は併存する。掲載されたFY2020表彰を2026年の新受賞とは扱わない。

en.business: Develops firewalls and integrated security products that protect enterprise networks, cloud environments, email and endpoints.
en.revenue: Earns from appliances and software plus recurring threat-prevention subscriptions, updates, maintenance and support.
en.strength: Combines long-developed threat intelligence and centralized management to enforce common policies from networks to cloud and endpoints.
en.risks: Slow cloud adaptation, price competition, missed threats or vulnerabilities, channel dependence, currencies and conditions in Israel can affect results.
en.competition: Network-security examples are Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet and Cisco. Cloud examples are CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Check Point names the companies; the latter two product examples are editorial comparisons against CloudGuard using official descriptions. Network, cloud and endpoint scopes differ; email/mobile competition is not assumed identical.
en.relationships: Reaches enterprises and governments through resellers and integrators, protecting cloud, network and endpoint environments through one management layer. Its Microsoft partner page describes Azure, Sentinel and Intune security integrations. Product integration coexists with competition against Microsoft security products. A displayed FY2020 award is not treated as a new 2026 award.

ja.strength: 多国間の通信網をAPIで扱え、メッセージ送信から顧客データ活用まで開発者が一つの基盤で組み込める。

ja.competition: 通信APIや顧客窓口向けサービスでは8x8が競合例。8x8自身の年次報告がTwilioを実名で挙げている。電話・メッセージなどをアプリへ組み込む機能と、顧客窓口の機能では比較する製品が異なり、全製品が同じという意味ではない。 音声APIではBandwidthとTwilio Programmable Voiceを公式製品で編集比較する。通信容量の購入・供給契約や全コンタクトセンター機能の同等性を意味しない。 顧客データでは、Segment UnifyとSalesforce Data 360（旧Data Cloud）の顧客ID・プロファイル統合を公式製品で編集比較する。UnifyはConnections Businessへの追加機能で、一部の活用にはEngageも必要。全CRM機能の同等性や両社間の購入契約を意味しない。
ja.relationships: 通信会社やメール網から接続を仕入れ、企業のアプリやコンタクトセンターへメッセージ、通話、認証を届ける。 2025年5月にMicrosoftとAzure AI Foundryを使う会話AIの複数年開発提携を発表。音声・メッセージ・担当者支援の開発計画で、全計画の提供完了やクラウドの契約額を推定しない。

en.business: Provides APIs and cloud software that embed messaging, voice, email and verification in apps and unify customer data.
en.revenue: Earns mainly usage-based communications fees, plus phone numbers, email, verification and Segment customer-data subscriptions.
en.strength: Developers can use one platform to reach communications networks across countries and connect customer interactions with data.
en.risks: Carrier fees, messaging regulation, lower customer usage, outages, abuse and price competition from clouds and API rivals can pressure margins.
en.competition: 8x8 is one example in overlapping communications API and contact-center markets. Its annual report explicitly names Twilio. Embedding communications in applications and operating contact-center workflows are different product scopes, rather than a match across every offering. Programmable voice APIs add an editorial comparison with Bandwidth using official products. This does not establish purchased network capacity, a supply contract or equivalent full contact-center portfolios. Customer data adds an editorial comparison of Segment Unify and Salesforce Data 360, formerly Data Cloud, for customer identity and profile unification. Unify is an add-on to Connections Business, with Engage also required for selected activation features. This does not equate all CRM functions or establish a purchase agreement.
en.relationships: Buys connectivity from carriers and email networks, then delivers messaging, calls and verification into enterprise apps and contact centers. A May 2025 announcement establishes a multiyear Microsoft conversational-AI development partnership using Azure AI Foundry. Voice, messaging and agent-assistance plans do not establish completed rollout of every feature or a disclosed cloud contract value.

ja.business: 契約書の作成、電子署名、保管、分析までをオンライン化するIntelligent Agreement Managementの会社。
ja.revenue: eSignatureや契約管理クラウドのサブスクが中心で、プロフェッショナルサービスなども一部収益になる。
ja.strength: 電子署名の知名度と大きな利用基盤を入口に、契約の作成前から締結後まで同じ基盤へ広げられる。
ja.risks: 電子署名の成熟、無料・同梱製品との競争、情報漏えい、各国の電子契約法やデータ保管規制が成長を左右する。
ja.competition: 電子署名ではAdobe Acrobat SignとDropbox Sign、契約作成から管理までのCLMではIcertisとIronclad、Microsoft 365内の基本的な署名ではMicrosoft eSignatureを比較する。AdobeはDocusign自身の明記、DropboxはDropbox側の開示、他は公式製品に基づく編集上の比較。Microsoft 365にはDocusignとの連携もあり、競合と連携が併存する。
ja.relationships: 企業の営業・法務・人事・購買部門が利用し、業務アプリや導入支援会社との連携で契約工程へ組み込む。 2026年9月のMicrosoft側の顧客事例は、Docusign IAMがAzureとFoundryを使うと説明。Docusign幹部の発言を含む基盤採用事例で、Azure経由のモデル利用をOpenAIとの直接容量契約に置き換えない。

en.business: Digitizes agreement creation, electronic signature, storage and analysis through its Intelligent Agreement Management platform.
en.revenue: Earns mainly subscriptions for eSignature and agreement-management cloud products, with services contributing a smaller share.
en.strength: Uses its well-known eSignature product and large user base to expand across the agreement process before and after signing.
en.risks: A maturing eSignature market, free or bundled rivals, data breaches and electronic-contract or residency rules can affect growth.
en.competition: E-signature examples are Adobe Acrobat Sign and Dropbox Sign; contract-lifecycle management examples are Icertis and Ironclad; Microsoft eSignature covers basic signing within Microsoft 365. Docusign names Adobe, Dropbox names Docusign, and the other examples are editorial official-product comparisons. Microsoft 365 also integrates Docusign, so competition and integration coexist.
en.relationships: Sales, legal, HR and procurement teams use the platform, integrated into workflows through business apps and implementation partners. A September 2026 Microsoft customer case, including Docusign executives, describes IAM using Azure and Foundry. Model access through Azure does not establish a direct OpenAI computing-capacity contract.

ja.business: 主に中小・中堅企業向けに、集客、営業、顧客対応、Web制作、決済を一つにまとめる顧客管理ソフト会社。
ja.revenue: Marketing、Sales、Serviceなど各Hubと統合版のサブスクが中心で、席数・機能・顧客データ量に応じて課金する。
ja.strength: 無料版から導入しやすく、顧客データを共通基盤に置いたまま必要なHubを追加でき、パートナー網も大きい。
ja.risks: 中小企業の景気感、顧客獲得費、解約、大手CRMとの競争、AIで既存機能が一般化するリスクが成長に影響する。
ja.competition: CRM・営業支援ではSalesforce、Freshworks、monday.comが競合例。HubSpot自身がSales HubとSalesforce Sales Cloudの比較を公開し、Freshworksとmonday.comもHubSpotをCRMの競合として挙げる。比較は顧客管理・営業の範囲で、各社の全製品が同じという意味ではない。
ja.relationships: OpenAIとは2026年9月にChatGPTのCRM・広告連携を拡大したと説明。AnthropicのClaude向けCRMコネクターは2025年7月に提供を発表した。顧客が許可したCRM情報とAIツールを接続する機能で、全顧客データの提供契約やAI企業によるHubSpot計算容量の購入を意味しない。

en.business: Provides a customer platform, mainly for small and mid-sized businesses, spanning marketing, sales, service, content and commerce.
en.revenue: Earns mainly subscriptions for individual Hubs and bundled suites, priced by seats, features and customer-data usage.
en.strength: A low-friction free entry point, shared customer data and expandable Hubs are reinforced by a broad partner ecosystem.
en.risks: SMB spending, customer acquisition costs, churn, large CRM rivals and AI commoditizing existing features can affect growth.
en.competition: Examples in CRM and sales software include Salesforce, Freshworks and monday.com. HubSpot publishes a Sales Hub versus Salesforce Sales Cloud comparison; Freshworks and monday.com name HubSpot as a CRM rival. This does not equate every product in their portfolios.
en.relationships: A September 2026 update expands OpenAI / ChatGPT CRM and advertising integration. HubSpot announced its Claude CRM connector in July 2025. These connect authorized customer context to AI tools; they are not blanket customer-data licensing agreements or purchases of HubSpot compute capacity by AI developers.

ja.business: ネット通販、実店舗、SNSなどの販売、在庫、決済、販促を一つにまとめる事業者向けコマース基盤。

ja.strength: 小規模店から大企業まで同じ基盤で成長でき、決済と2万超のアプリを含む豊富なパートナー網を持つ。
ja.risks: 加盟店や消費の減速、決済損失、競争、障害、クラウド費、アプリ・決済・AIなど外部事業者への依存が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: ECサイト・コマース基盤ではAdobe CommerceとWix、実店舗のPOS・決済ではBlockのSquareが競合例。前2社は公表製品の編集上の比較。SquareはShopify自身のPOS比較資料と両社の公式製品で照合した。決済で連携する会社が全製品で競合するとは限らない。
ja.relationships: 加盟店へ販売・決済基盤を提供し、アプリ開発者や制作会社が機能を拡張し、決済・クラウド会社が処理基盤を支える。 2026年1月の自社発表はGoogleとUCPを共同開発し、AI Mode / Geminiの決済機能を展開予定と説明。ChatGPT向け連携もAgentic Storefrontsで管理する。商品・決済連携を計算容量購入と混同せず、発表時の展開計画を全加盟店で完了済みとは扱わない。

en.business: Provides a commerce platform that combines online, retail and social selling with inventory, payments and marketing.
en.revenue: Earns from Subscription Solutions and from Merchant Solutions such as payments, transaction-linked services and financial products.
en.strength: One platform can scale from small sellers to large brands, reinforced by payments and an ecosystem of more than 20,000 apps.
en.risks: Merchant or consumer weakness, payment losses, competition, outages, cloud costs and dependence on app, payments and AI providers can affect profits.
en.competition: Adobe Commerce and Wix are examples in ecommerce storefront/platform software, while Block’s Square overlaps in retail POS and payments. The first two are editorial product comparisons; Square is also covered by Shopify’s own POS comparison. Integration and competition can coexist in different product areas.
en.relationships: Provides selling and payment tools to merchants; developers and agencies extend the platform while payment and cloud providers support processing. Its January 2026 announcement describes UCP co-development with Google and planned AI Mode / Gemini checkout. ChatGPT integrations are managed through Agentic Storefronts. These are commerce integrations; planned rollout is not assumed complete for every merchant.

ja.business: AI広告基盤Axonで、広告主の集客とアプリ会社の広告収益化を結びつける広告テクノロジー会社。
ja.revenue: Axon Ads Managerによる広告収益がほぼ全てで、広告主の需要とアプリ・Web・CTVの広告枠を自動で組み合わせる。
ja.strength: 大規模な広告入札データがAxon AIの推薦精度を高め、成果が上がるほど広告主と広告枠が増える循環を作る。
ja.risks: AppleやGoogleなどの規約・識別子変更、個人情報規制、広告需要、推定精度、少数の配信基盤への依存が業績を大きく動かす。
ja.competition: AppLovin自身はGoogle・Meta・Amazon・Unityを広告分野の競合に挙げる。広告主の予算、利用者の獲得、アプリ等の広告枠が比較対象で、Unityは公式の広告獲得製品を照合した。ゲーム制作エンジンそのものとの比較ではなく、広告仲介、計測、CTVでは製品範囲が異なる。競合が取引相手を兼ねる場合もある。
ja.relationships: 広告主の入札をアプリ・Web・CTVの広告枠へつなぎ、AppleやGoogleなどの配信基盤の規約下でサービスを動かす。 Google CloudとAppLovin幹部による2023年12月の事例は、広告AI基盤でG2 VMとGKEを利用したと説明。クラウド供給元Googleとの広告競争は併存し、過去の事例から現在の契約額やNVIDIAとの直接調達契約を推定しない。

en.business: Uses its Axon AI advertising platform to connect advertiser acquisition goals with publisher monetization.
en.revenue: Almost all revenue comes from Axon Ads Manager, which matches advertiser demand with app, web and connected-TV inventory.
en.strength: Large-scale auction data improves Axon AI recommendations, creating a cycle in which better results attract more advertisers and inventory.
en.risks: Apple or Google policy and identifier changes, privacy rules, ad demand, model performance and dependence on a few distribution platforms can move results sharply.
en.competition: AppLovin names Google, Meta, Amazon and Unity in advertising. Comparisons concern advertiser budgets, user acquisition and advertising inventory; Unity is matched to official user-acquisition products, not its game-development engine. Mediation, measurement and CTV differ in scope, and competitors may also be counterparties.
en.relationships: Matches advertiser bids to app, web and CTV inventory while operating under the policies of distribution platforms such as Apple and Google. A December 2023 case coauthored by Google Cloud and an AppLovin executive describes G2 VM / GKE use for advertising AI. Cloud supply coexists with advertising competition; the dated case does not establish current contract amounts or direct NVIDIA procurement.

ja.business: 住宅などの宿泊先、体験、旅行中のサービスを提供するホストと利用者を結ぶ世界的な旅行市場。
ja.revenue: 予約金額に対するサービス料が中心で、宿泊開始時に売上を認識する。2025年からホスト側の単一料金へ移行を始めた。
ja.strength: 世界中の多様な宿泊在庫と強いブランド、ホストとゲストが互いを呼ぶネットワーク、決済・安全支援を一体で持つ。

ja.competition: 宿泊予約ではBooking HoldingsのBooking.com、貸切住宅ではExpedia GroupのVrbo、ホテル滞在ではMarriottのホテル群が比較例。Airbnbの開示する競合分野と相手側の公式サービスを照合した編集上の比較で、ホテルと民泊の全体が同じ商品ではない。Alphabet／Googleとは旅行検索で競合する。体験予約やホスト獲得は別に確認する。
ja.relationships: ホストの宿泊・体験・サービスをゲストへ仲介し、カード網、銀行、決済会社を通じて代金を回収・送金する。 2026年9月の自社発表はOpenAIのフロンティアモデルへのアクセス拡張契約を説明し、優先クラウド供給元をAWSと明記。OpenAI APIとAmazon Bedrockを使う開発・製品用途で、宿泊予約の全処理委託や出資ではない。

en.revenue: Earns mainly service fees tied to bookings and recognizes revenue at check-in; it began shifting toward a host-only single-fee structure in 2025.
en.strength: Combines diverse global inventory, a strong brand, host-guest network effects, payments and trust support.
en.risks: Short-term rental rules, safety incidents, fraud, travel demand, host supply, insurance, payments and local laws can constrain growth.
en.competition: Accommodation examples are Booking Holdings’ Booking.com, Expedia Group’s Vrbo whole-home rentals and Marriott hotels. These are editorial comparisons of official services with Airbnb’s competitive categories; hotels and home stays are not identical products. Alphabet/Google also competes in travel search. Experiences and host acquisition require separate review.
en.relationships: Matches host stays, experiences and services with guests and uses card networks, banks and processors to collect and remit payments. Its September 2026 announcement describes expanded OpenAI frontier-model access and identifies AWS as its preferred cloud provider. OpenAI APIs and Amazon Bedrock support engineering / product work; this does not establish outsourced booking operations or investment.

ja.business: 音楽、ポッドキャスト、オーディオブックを個人ごとに推薦して配信する世界的な音声サービス。
ja.revenue: Premiumなどの月額契約が中心で、無料版では音声・動画・表示広告を広告主や代理店へ販売する。
ja.strength: 大きな利用者基盤と再生データを使った推薦、無料版から有料版へ移す導線、複数音声形式を一つに集める点が強い。
ja.risks: レーベル・出版社への権利料、契約更新、Appleなど端末基盤との競争、値上げ・解約、広告市況が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 音楽ではApple Music・YouTube Music・Amazon Music、音声書籍ではApple Books・Amazon Audibleなどが競合例。Spotify自身の分野別開示に基づく。MetaとByteDanceとは、Facebook等やTikTok・Douyinなどで利用時間や広告予算を争う文脈で区別する。これらを有料音楽サービスと同じ商品とは扱わない。
ja.relationships: レーベル、出版社、制作者から音源・番組の権利を得て利用者へ配信し、通信会社経由でも有料契約を販売する。 2026年5月、NetflixとJay ShettyのOn Purpose動画配信協業を発表し、7月13日の提供開始を予定。Spotifyが番組の世界広告販売を担うと説明する。番組別の契約であり、全音楽・全ポッドキャストの独占提供とは扱わない。

en.business: Streams personalized music, podcasts and audiobooks to users worldwide.
en.revenue: Earns mainly monthly Premium and related subscriptions, while the free service sells audio, video and display ads to brands and agencies.
en.strength: A large user base, personalization data, free-to-paid conversion and multiple audio formats reinforce engagement.
en.risks: Label and publisher royalties, contract renewals, competition from device platforms, price-related churn and ad markets can affect profits.
en.competition: Music examples are Apple Music, YouTube Music and Amazon Music; audiobook examples include Apple Books and Amazon Audible, based on Spotify’s own field-specific disclosures. Meta and ByteDance also compete for attention and advertising through Facebook and short-video products such as TikTok/Douyin. These are not treated as identical paid-music services.
en.relationships: Licenses music and programs from labels, publishers and creators, distributes them to listeners and also sells subscriptions through telecom partners. A May 2026 announcement describes Netflix / Jay Shetty collaboration for On Purpose video, with July 13 launch planned and Spotify representing global advertising sales for the show. This is program-specific, without implying exclusivity over all music or podcasts.

ja.business: 興味ごとのコミュニティで利用者が投稿・議論し、知識や体験を蓄積するソーシャルプラットフォーム。
ja.revenue: 主に企業や代理店へ広告枠を販売し、公開投稿データのライセンス供与などからも収益を得る。
ja.strength: 利用者とモデレーターが継続的に作る会話データ、細かな関心別コミュニティ、投稿が投稿を呼ぶネットワーク効果が強い。
ja.risks: 不適切投稿の管理、検索や生成AIへの利用流出、広告市況、個人情報規制、アプリ配信基盤への依存が利用と収益を左右する。
ja.competition: Reddit自身は情報探索、娯楽、趣味の交流、広告で競争する企業を分けて開示する。広告予算ではGoogle・Meta・Snap・Pinterest・TikTok、交流ではFacebook GroupsやPinterestなどが例。Googleの検索・YouTube、生成AIによる情報探索は役割が異なり、全サービスが同じ機能という意味ではない。TikTokの事業・合弁会社を一律に単独所有と扱わない。
ja.relationships: 2025年年次報告はAWSとGoogle Cloudの基盤利用を実名で開示。Googleとは2024年2月にData APIとVertex AIの提携、OpenAIとは2024年5月にData API・AI機能・広告の提携を発表した。検索・広告での競争と協業は併存する。発表時点の予定から現在の契約量や全機能の提供完了を推定しない。

en.business: A social platform where people post and discuss interests inside communities, building a store of knowledge and experience.
en.revenue: Earns mainly by selling advertising to brands and agencies, with additional revenue from licensing public content data.
en.strength: Continuously refreshed conversations, highly specific interest communities and user-moderator network effects support engagement.
en.risks: Content safety, traffic shifting to search or generative AI, advertising cycles, privacy rules and distribution-platform dependence can affect growth.
en.competition: Reddit separates information seeking, entertainment, interests and advertising. Named advertising peers include Google, Meta, Snap, Pinterest and TikTok; interest-based alternatives include Facebook Groups and Pinterest. Search, YouTube and generative-AI information seeking differ in function. TikTok businesses and affiliated joint ventures are not treated as uniformly wholly owned.
en.relationships: The FY2025 filing explicitly identifies AWS and Google Cloud infrastructure use. Google announced a Data API/Vertex AI partnership in February 2024; OpenAI announced Data API, AI-feature and advertising collaboration in May 2024. Search/advertising competition and collaboration coexist. Announcement plans do not establish current volumes or delivery of all features.

ja.strength: 購入前の計画段階で使われる画像データ、検索意図、AIによる推薦と商品発見の組み合わせが強い。
ja.risks: 広告収入への依存、利用者の成長と継続、プライバシー規制、検索・生成AIとの競争、外部コンテンツへの依存が弱点。
ja.competition: Pinterest自身が挙げるGoogle・Meta・Snap・Reddit・TikTokは、利用時間や広告予算の競合。Amazonは商品探索・購買意図のある利用者と広告の比較例でもある。Google Lens・Gemini・YouTube、生成AIやECは役割が異なり、画像の発見機能すべての互換性は意味しない。TikTok関連事業には合弁会社も含む。
ja.relationships: AWS（Amazon）は主要な計算・保存基盤。Amazonとは2023年4月に第三者広告の提携を発表した。Google・Appleのログイン基盤への依存も開示しており、広告競合と基盤利用・提携は別の関係として併存する。

en.business: A visual discovery service for saving and organizing images and videos around home, style, travel, shopping and other ideas.
en.revenue: Makes money by selling image and video ads to brands and merchants based on users' interests and discovery intent.
en.strength: Planning-stage intent, a rich image corpus and AI recommendations that connect inspiration with product discovery are key strengths.
en.risks: Advertising dependence, user retention, privacy rules, search and generative-AI competition, and reliance on third-party content are risks.
en.competition: Pinterest names Google, Meta, Snap, Reddit and TikTok in competition for engagement and advertising. Amazon also illustrates product discovery, commercial intent and ads. Google Lens, Gemini, YouTube, generative AI and commerce differ in function; visual-discovery products are not assumed interchangeable. TikTok-related businesses include affiliated joint ventures.
en.relationships: AWS (Amazon) provides major computing and storage infrastructure. Pinterest announced an Amazon advertising partnership in April 2023 and discloses dependencies on Google and Apple login platforms. Infrastructure, advertising collaboration and competition are distinct roles.

en.revenue: Earns mainly from advertising sold to brands and agencies, with additional subscription revenue such as Snapchat+.
en.strength: A camera-first interface, younger audience, private friend communication, AR technology and creator tools differentiate the service.
en.risks: Advertising dependence, user growth, youth safety, privacy rules, and Apple or Google platform-policy changes are major risks.
en.competition: Snap names Alphabet, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit and ByteDance with TikTok-affiliated joint ventures in engagement and advertising. YouTube concerns video and Instagram includes Stories. Device cameras and messaging remain alternatives; this is not equivalence across AR hardware or all ad services. Platform dependence and competition can coexist.
en.relationships: Google Cloud and AWS (Amazon) provide major compute, storage and bandwidth infrastructure. Google Android/Play and Apple iOS/App Store support app distribution. Cloud procurement differs from operating-system and distribution dependencies.

ja.business: 利用者が3Dゲームや交流空間を作り、遊び、仮想アイテムを売買できるオンライン創作プラットフォーム。
ja.revenue: 利用者が購入した仮想通貨Robuxを体験内アイテムや機能に使うことで稼ぎ、制作者へ一部を分配する。
ja.strength: 無料の制作ツール、膨大な利用者制作コンテンツ、利用者と制作者が互いを増やすネットワーク効果が強い。
ja.risks: 未成年者の安全と投稿管理、制作者の定着、Apple・Googleへの高い配信依存、規制、障害が利用と利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 利用時間や創作ではMicrosoftのMinecraft、Meta Horizon、Epic GamesのFortnite/UEFN、Unityの制作エンジンが競合例。Roblox自身が4社を挙げ、製品を公式情報で照合した。Metaは2026年にWorldsのモバイル重視を説明している。遊ぶ場と制作ソフトは役割が異なり、Unityで作る作品がRobloxと同じ配信・収益構造になるわけではない。
ja.relationships: 制作者が体験とアイテムを供給し、利用者がRobuxで購入する。AppleやGoogleなどが配信と決済を担う。

en.business: An online creation platform where users build and play 3D experiences, socialize and trade virtual items.
en.revenue: Earns when users buy and spend the virtual currency Robux on in-experience items and features, sharing part with creators.
en.strength: Free creation tools, a large catalog of user-generated content and reinforcing user-creator network effects are key advantages.
en.risks: Youth safety and moderation, creator retention, heavy Apple and Google distribution dependence, regulation and outages can affect results.
en.competition: Examples are Microsoft Minecraft, Meta Horizon, Epic Games Fortnite/UEFN and Unity creation tools, based on Roblox named-vendor disclosure and official products. Meta described a mobile focus for Worlds in 2026. A playable platform and a development engine have different roles; Unity projects do not automatically share Roblox distribution or monetization.
en.relationships: Creators supply experiences and items, users purchase them with Robux, and platforms such as Apple and Google distribute and process payments.

ja.business: テレビ向けOS、動画検索・視聴画面、広告配信、自社チャンネル、再生機器をまとめて提供するストリーミング基盤。
ja.revenue: 広告枠、動画サービスの契約・課金分配、リモコンのブランドボタンなどのPlatform収益と機器販売で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: テレビのホーム画面と視聴データ、多数の動画サービスへの入口、OSから広告まで一体で運営する点が強い。
ja.risks: 広告市況、動画会社との契約更新、個人情報規制、機器の低採算、テレビメーカーや大手端末基盤との競争が弱点。
ja.competition: テレビ向け端末・OSではAmazonのFire TV、AppleのApple TV端末、AlphabetのGoogle TV・Android TV、Walmart傘下のVIZIO・Onnが競合例。Roku自身が実名を記載している。VIZIOは独立した別会社として重複追加せず、動画広告や番組の競争とは分けて示す。
ja.relationships: テレビメーカーや小売を通じて端末を広げ、動画会社を利用者へ配信し、広告主へテレビ広告枠を販売する。 2025年6月のAmazon Ads / Roku共同発表は、Amazon DSPを通じる米国CTVの認証済み到達・広告測定連携を説明し、2025年第四半期までの提供を予定した。特定の広告機能の提携で、全Roku広告の独占販売や全地域への提供完了とは扱わない。 2026年6月15日にRokuとFox Corporation（Nasdaq FOXA/FOX）は買収契約を公表した。現金とFOX株式を組み合わせる取引で、発表時は2027年前半の完了予定と通常の完了条件を示した。契約発表を買収完了や現時点の株式保有とは扱わない。

en.business: A TV streaming platform combining an operating system, discovery interface, advertising, its own channel and player devices.
en.revenue: Earns platform revenue from advertising, streaming-service distribution and billing shares, and branded remote buttons, plus device sales.
en.strength: Control of the TV home screen, viewing data, broad service discovery and integrated OS-to-ad operations are key advantages.
en.risks: Ad cycles, content-contract renewals, privacy limits, low-margin devices and competition from TV makers and larger device ecosystems are risks.
en.competition: Roku explicitly names Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV devices, Google/Android TV and Walmart’s VIZIO/Onn products in streaming-device and TV-OS competition. VIZIO is represented under Walmart rather than as another independent issuer. This scope is distinct from video-content and advertising competition.
en.relationships: TV makers and retailers distribute devices, streaming services reach viewers through Roku, and advertisers buy connected-TV inventory. The June 2025 Amazon Ads / Roku announcement describes authenticated US CTV reach and measurement through Amazon DSP, planned by Q4 2025. The partnership concerns specified advertising capabilities, without implying exclusive sale of all Roku ads or completed worldwide availability. On June 15, 2026, Roku and Fox Corporation (Nasdaq FOXA/FOX) announced an acquisition agreement involving cash and FOX shares. The announcement expected closing in the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions. An agreement announcement is not a completed acquisition or proof of current share ownership.

ja.revenue: 基盤を通じて購入された広告費に応じた利用料を広告主や代理店から受け取り、データなどの追加機能でも稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 媒体を保有しない独立性、多数の広告在庫を横断する買い付け、データ・測定・最適化技術が強い。
ja.risks: 広告市況、Cookieや端末IDの制限、広告在庫・データ会社への依存、大口代理店の集中、巨大広告基盤との競争が弱点。
ja.competition: 広告主や代理店が広告枠を買い付けるDSPでは、AlphabetのGoogle事業とAmazonが競合例。The Trade Desk自身が実名を挙げている。Googleは広告在庫の供給元でもあり、買い付け基盤での競争と在庫調達の関係は両立する。
ja.relationships: 広告主と代理店が買い手となり、媒体社・広告取引所から広告枠を調達し、データ・測定会社と連携する。 2025年9月の自社記事はSpotify Ad Exchangeの音声・動画広告在庫をThe Trade Deskから購入できると説明。媒体在庫への接続・広告販売協業で、Spotifyの全音楽データ提供や計算容量購入ではない。

en.business: A demand-side platform used by advertisers and agencies to buy and measure connected-TV, video, audio and display ads programmatically.
en.revenue: Charges platform fees tied to advertising spend placed through the system, with additional fees for data and related features.
en.strength: Independence from owned media, access across many inventory sources, and data, measurement and optimization technology are advantages.
en.risks: Ad cycles, cookie and device-ID restrictions, inventory and data dependencies, agency concentration and competition from large platforms are risks.
en.competition: The Trade Desk explicitly names Google and Amazon as demand-side advertising-platform competitors. The overlap concerns advertiser/agency buying tools. Google is also an advertising-inventory supplier in its filing, so platform competition and inventory sourcing can coexist.
en.relationships: Advertisers and agencies are buyers, publishers and exchanges provide inventory, and data and measurement vendors support targeting and results. Its September 2025 article describes access to Spotify Ad Exchange audio / video inventory through The Trade Desk. This is publisher-inventory integration and advertising collaboration, without implying access to all music data or computing-capacity purchases.

ja.business: 飲食店、小売店、買い物客、配達員を結び、料理や日用品を注文・配送する地域商取引プラットフォーム。
ja.revenue: 加盟店手数料、利用者の配達・サービス料、DashPass会費、加盟店やブランド向け広告から稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 加盟店、注文者、配達員が互いを増やす地域密度、配達技術、飲食以外へ広がる品ぞろえが強い。
ja.risks: 配達員の雇用区分規制、保険と事故、配送品質、販促費、加盟店・利用者・配達員の離脱が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 料理配達ではUber Eats、食品・日用品の配送ではAmazon、Instacart、Walmartが競合例。Uber・AmazonはDoorDash自身の実名開示、Instacart・Walmartは公式サービスとDoorDashの対象分野を比較した編集上の例。加盟店の直接注文・自社配送や店頭購入も代替で、地域や品ぞろえ、配送体制は各社で異なる。
ja.relationships: 加盟店が商品を供給し、配達員が注文を運び、利用者が購入する。加盟店やブランドには広告枠も販売する。 2026年5月に米国Kroger系列約2,700店でSNAP / EBTを使う食料品配達決済を開始。7月には米国に実店舗を持つShopify加盟店向け販売チャネル連携を開始した。海外展開計画や期限付き配達料優遇を恒久・全地域の条件とは扱わない。

en.business: A local-commerce platform connecting restaurants, retailers, consumers and couriers to order and deliver meals and everyday goods.
en.revenue: Earns merchant commissions, consumer delivery and service fees, DashPass subscriptions, and advertising from merchants and brands.
en.strength: Local density across merchants, consumers and Dashers, logistics technology, and expansion beyond restaurants reinforce the network.
en.risks: Courier-classification rules, insurance and safety, delivery quality, promotions, and retention of merchants, consumers and Dashers affect profits.
en.competition: Uber Eats in meal delivery and Amazon, Instacart and Walmart in grocery/everyday delivery are examples. DoorDash names Uber and Amazon; Instacart and Walmart are editorial comparisons of official services with DoorDash scope. Direct merchant ordering, merchant fleets and in-store shopping remain alternatives. Geography, selection and delivery models differ.
en.relationships: Merchants supply goods, Dashers deliver orders, consumers purchase them, and merchants and brands also buy advertising inventory. In May 2026 it launched SNAP / EBT grocery-delivery payments at nearly 2,700 US Kroger-family stores. July brought a Shopify sales channel for merchants with US physical stores. Planned international expansion and temporary fee promotions are not assumed permanent or worldwide.

ja.relationships: 販売事業者が商品を出品し、買い手が購入する。加盟店・利用者には決済、口座、融資を提供し、配送網と連携する。 Mercado Pagoのメキシコ公式商品ページはVisa対応クレジットカードを明記。メキシコの商品・決済ネットワークの関係であり、他国の全決済やVisaによる出資を示さない。

en.business: A Latin American commerce and financial-services company combining a marketplace, payments, digital accounts, logistics, ads and credit.
en.revenue: Earns marketplace fees, shipping and advertising revenue, payment-processing fees and credit interest across commerce and Mercado Pago.
en.strength: A regional network linking buyers, sellers, payments, logistics and credit, supported by locally built infrastructure, is the core advantage.
en.risks: Currency and inflation, country regulation, credit losses, logistics costs, fraud and competition across both commerce and finance are risks.
en.competition: Commerce examples are Amazon and Sea’s Shopee in Brazil. In financial services, Nu/Nubank accounts, cards and lending in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia overlap selected Mercado Pago offerings. These are editorial comparisons of official local services, not an assertion of identical coverage across Latin America or that MercadoLibre explicitly names these companies.
en.relationships: Sellers list goods and buyers purchase them; merchants and consumers also use payments, accounts and credit connected to logistics networks. Mercado Pago’s official Mexico product page identifies its Visa-backed credit card. This establishes a Mexico product / payment-network relationship, without implying all payments in other countries or a Visa equity investment.

ja.business: PayPalとVenmoを中心に、個人と事業者のオンライン・店頭決済、送金、請求、信用をつなぐ決済基盤。
ja.revenue: 決済額と取引件数に応じた手数料が中心で、融資、即時出金、為替などの付加サービスでも稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 買い手と売り手の二面ネットワーク、決済データ、不正検知、複数の資金源を一つにつなぐチェックアウトが強い。
ja.risks: 不正・取引損失、規制、加盟店価格、ブランド決済の競争、カード網・銀行・処理会社への依存が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: デジタル財布・オンライン支払いではApple Pay、加盟店向け決済処理ではStripe、Venmoの送金や加盟店決済ではBlockのCash App・Square、後払いではAffirmが競合例。各社の公表製品を照合した編集上の比較で、PayPal自身の実名列挙ではない。決済手段として相互利用できる場合もある。
ja.relationships: 個人が支払い・送金し、加盟店が代金を受け取る。銀行、カード網、処理会社が入出金と決済を支える。 2025年10月、OpenAIのInstant CheckoutとACPに対応する決済提携を発表し、加盟店商品カタログの展開は2026年計画と説明。PayPalの決済処理とChatGPT Enterprise / Codex利用は異なる用途で、全加盟店の提供開始やAI計算容量購入とは扱わない。

en.business: A payments platform centered on PayPal and Venmo that connects consumers and merchants across checkout, transfers, invoicing and credit.
en.revenue: Earns mainly transaction fees tied to payment volume and activity, plus credit, instant transfer, foreign-exchange and other services.
en.strength: A two-sided buyer-seller network, payment data, fraud controls and checkout across multiple funding sources are key advantages.
en.risks: Fraud and transaction losses, regulation, merchant pricing, branded-checkout competition and dependence on banks and card networks are risks.
en.competition: Examples include Apple Pay in wallet/online checkout, Stripe in merchant processing, Block’s Cash App/Square in P2P and merchant payments, and Affirm in BNPL. These are editorial comparisons of disclosed products, not PayPal’s explicit named list. Payment providers may also support one another’s methods.
en.relationships: Consumers pay and transfer funds, merchants receive payments, and banks, card networks and processors support money movement and settlement. Its October 2025 OpenAI partnership covers Instant Checkout / ACP payments, with merchant catalogs planned for 2026. Payment processing and internal ChatGPT Enterprise / Codex use have different roles; completed rollout to every merchant and AI capacity purchases are not inferred.

ja.business: Squareで事業者の決済・業務を、Cash Appで個人の送金・カード・貯蓄・投資を支える金融技術企業。
ja.revenue: 加盟店決済と業務ソフト、Cash Appの即時送金・カード・金融商品、BNPL、ビットコイン取引などから稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 決済端末からソフト・融資まで揃うSquareと、日常金融を集約するCash Appの二つの生態系と取引データが強い。
ja.risks: 不正・貸倒れ、金融規制、銀行・カード網への依存、激しい決済競争、ビットコイン価格と取引量の変動が弱点。
ja.competition: Squareの店舗POSではShopify POS、Cash Appの送金や加盟店決済ではPayPal・Venmo、Afterpayの後払いではAffirmが競合例。ShopifyのSquare比較と各社の公表製品を照合しており、送金、店舗運営、後払いを同じ市場として扱わない。
ja.relationships: 事業者がSquareで販売・決済し、個人がCash Appを使う。銀行、カード網、処理会社が決済と口座機能を支える。 Squareの米国公式サポートは、対象Squareプランと飲食店POSモードでDoorDash注文・メニュー・営業時間等を同期できると説明。製品連携であり、DoorDash自身を加盟飲食店顧客とみなしたり、全プラン・全地域に一般化しない。

en.business: A financial-technology company serving sellers through Square and consumers through Cash App transfers, cards, savings and investing.
en.revenue: Earns from merchant payments and software, Cash App transfers, cards and financial products, BNPL and bitcoin transactions.
en.strength: Square's integrated hardware, software and finance plus Cash App's consumer ecosystem and first-party transaction data are advantages.
en.risks: Fraud and credit losses, financial regulation, bank and card-network dependence, intense payments competition and bitcoin volatility are risks.
en.competition: Examples include Shopify POS versus Square, PayPal/Venmo versus Cash App and merchant payments, and Affirm versus Afterpay BNPL. Shopify’s Square comparison and official product descriptions support these scoped examples. Retail operations, P2P and installment lending are separate product areas.
en.relationships: Sellers use Square and consumers use Cash App, while banks, card networks and processors support payments and account functions. Square’s US support page describes DoorDash order, menu and opening-hours integration for eligible plans and restaurant POS modes. This is product integration; DoorDash is not inferred to be a restaurant merchant customer, and availability is not generalized to all plans or countries.

ja.business: 語学を中心に数学、音楽、チェスもゲーム感覚で学べるモバイル・Web学習サービスと英語試験を提供する。
ja.revenue: Super DuolingoとDuolingo Maxの月額・年額契約が中心で、広告、アプリ内購入、英語試験でも稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 無料で始められる導線、習慣化を促すゲーム設計、学習データを使う個別最適化、強いブランドが成長を支える。
ja.risks: 学習継続と有料化、AIによる競争と内容品質、Apple・Googleへの配信依存、個人情報・未成年者対応が弱点。
ja.competition: 語学アプリではBabbel、AI会話練習ではSpeakeasy LabsのSpeak、英語力試験ではPearsonのPTE AcademicとETSのTOEFL iBTが比較例。各社の公式サービスとDuolingoの対象分野を照合した編集上の競合例。学習アプリと試験を分け、試験の採用校・用途や受験方式が同じとはしない。
ja.relationships: 学習者と有料会員へ教材を提供し、学校・大学は英語試験を受け入れ、アプリ配信基盤が契約決済を担う。 2023年3月の自社発表で、OpenAI GPT-4を使うDuolingo Maxを対象市場のiOS向けに提供。時点を限定した製品採用であり、当時のモデル・機能・対応市場が現在も全て同じとは扱わない。

en.business: A mobile and web learning service offering game-like language, math, music and chess courses plus an English proficiency test.
en.revenue: Earns mainly Super Duolingo and Duolingo Max subscriptions, with additional ads, in-app purchases and English Test revenue.
en.strength: A free entry point, habit-forming game design, data-driven personalization and a strong brand support growth and conversion.
en.risks: Learner retention and paid conversion, AI competition and content quality, Apple and Google dependence, privacy and youth safety are risks.
en.competition: Language-learning examples include Babbel and Speakeasy Labs’ Speak AI conversation tutor. English-assessment examples are Pearson PTE Academic and ETS TOEFL iBT. These are editorial comparisons of official services with Duolingo’s scope, not a company-named list. Learning apps and tests differ, including acceptance, purposes and delivery methods.
en.relationships: Learners and subscribers use courses, schools and universities recognize the English Test, and app platforms handle distribution and billing. Its March 2023 release identifies OpenAI GPT-4 in Duolingo Max for iOS in selected markets. This is dated product adoption, without assuming every original model, feature or market remains unchanged today.

ja.business: 半導体の欠陥を見つけ、寸法や位置ずれを測る検査・計測装置と解析ソフトを作る会社。先端パッケージや特殊半導体にも対応する。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーや組立・検査会社への装置販売に加え、ソフト、保守、交換部品で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 光学検査、計測、工程データ解析を一体で提供できる。微細化だけでなく、複数チップを組み合わせる先端パッケージにも強い。
ja.risks: 半導体設備投資の波、大口顧客の発注、輸出規制の影響を受ける。新装置の認定遅れや部品不足も売上時期を動かす。
ja.competition: 半導体の検査・計測ではKLA、寸法や薄膜などの計測ではNovaが競合例。両社の年次報告はOnto Innovationを実名で挙げている。欠陥検査、膜厚・寸法計測、先端パッケージなどで比較する装置や用途は異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場と組立・検査会社へ装置とソフトを供給し、稼働後は保守や部品交換で量産を支える。 SK hynixとのHBM生産向けDragonfly G5検査協力は2026年10月の自社発表で確認。TSMCも2025年11月にOntoの生産支援を供給者表彰した。表彰対象の関係を示し、特定装置の購入数量は未開示。

en.business: Makes inspection and metrology tools and analytics software that find defects and measure dimensions and overlay in semiconductor production, including advanced packaging and specialty devices.
en.revenue: Earns from system sales to chipmakers and assembly-and-test providers, plus software, service and replacement parts.
en.strength: Combines optical inspection, metrology and process-data analytics, serving both device scaling and multi-chip advanced packaging.
en.risks: Semiconductor spending cycles, large-customer orders and export controls affect demand; qualification delays and component shortages can shift revenue timing.
en.competition: Examples include KLA in semiconductor inspection and metrology, and Nova in critical-dimension and thin-film metrology. Both explicitly name Onto Innovation in annual filings. Defect inspection, dimensional measurement and packaging applications have different equipment requirements.
en.relationships: Supplies tools and software to wafer fabs and assembly-and-test providers, then supports production through service and replacement parts. An October 2026 company release confirms Dragonfly G5 inspection collaboration with SK hynix in HBM production. TSMC recognized Onto production support in November 2025. These awards establish the disclosed relationships without individual tool purchase volumes.

ja.business: 出荷前の半導体や電子部品を自動で検査する装置を作る会社。協働ロボットと自律搬送ロボットも手がける。
ja.revenue: 半導体・製品テスト装置と保守、Universal Robotsの協働ロボット、MiRの搬送ロボットの販売で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 複雑なSoCやメモリーを高速に大量検査する装置、長年の導入実績、世界各地の技術支援が強み。ロボットは扱いやすさを重視する。
ja.risks: 半導体の新製品投入と設備投資に売上が左右され、大口顧客への集中もある。ロボット需要の弱さや部品供給、輸出規制も負担になる。
ja.competition: 半導体テスターではAdvantestとCohu、製品試験ではKeysight、ロボットでは協働アームのDoosan Roboticsや自律搬送のOmronが競合例。いずれもTeradyne自身の年次報告に実名がある。半導体、電子機器の試験、工場の搬送では比較する製品が異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体メーカーや受託組立・検査会社へテスト装置を供給し、工場や物流現場へ協働・搬送ロボットを販売する。 FY2025年次報告書では、FlexにマレーシアでFLEX・J750の製造と試験を委託。Plexusにはマレーシア・タイでFLEX・Magnum、マレーシアでETSを委託する。FLEXはテスト装置の商品名でもあり、供給企業Flexと区別する。

en.business: Builds automated equipment that tests semiconductors and electronic products before shipment, and also sells collaborative and autonomous mobile robots.
en.revenue: Earns from semiconductor and product-test systems and service, Universal Robots cobots and MiR mobile robots.
en.strength: Combines high-throughput testing for complex SoCs and memory with a large installed base and global support; its robots emphasize ease of deployment.
en.risks: Revenue depends on semiconductor launches and capital spending and is concentrated among major customers; weak robotics demand, component supply and export controls add risk.
en.competition: Teradyne names Advantest and Cohu in semiconductor test, Keysight in product test, Doosan Robotics in collaborative arms and Omron in autonomous mobile robots. These are separate test and automation applications.
en.relationships: Supplies testers to chipmakers and outsourced assembly-and-test providers, and sells collaborative and mobile robots into factories and logistics sites. Its FY2025 annual report identifies Flex manufacturing and testing FLEX / J750 in Malaysia, and Plexus manufacturing and testing FLEX / Magnum in Malaysia and Thailand and ETS in Malaysia. The FLEX system brand is distinct from supplier Flex.

ja.business: 半導体工場で使う超高純度の材料、フィルター、薬液・ガス搬送部品を作り、微小な汚染から製造工程を守る会社。
ja.revenue: 工場で繰り返し交換される材料・フィルター・容器と、流体管理システムを半導体メーカーや装置会社へ販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 材料科学、ろ過、流体管理を幅広く持ち、顧客の工程開発段階から品質と純度を作り込める。消耗品が継続収益につながる。
ja.risks: 半導体生産量と設備投資の波、顧客集中、原材料不足、輸出規制の影響を受ける。買収で増えた負債と事業統合も負担。
ja.competition: Entegris自身は部門別に競合を開示する。Pall（Danaher傘下）は高純度化ソリューション、Merck KGaAのEMD Performance Materialsは材料分野の比較対象。Merck KGaAは米国製薬会社Merck & Co.とは別企業。ろ過・材料・搬送の全製品を互換とせず、製品別に範囲が異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場と製造装置メーカーへ材料、フィルター、搬送部品を供給し、量産工程の汚染管理を支える。 FY2025自社開示ではTSMCが売上の16%を占める。半導体材料や汚染管理製品等の顧客であり、顧客別の全製品内訳や将来の最低発注量を示すものではない。

en.business: Makes ultra-pure materials, filters and chemical-and-gas delivery components that protect semiconductor processes from microscopic contamination.
en.revenue: Sells recurring materials, filters and containers plus fluid-management systems to chipmakers and equipment manufacturers.
en.strength: Its breadth across materials science, filtration and fluid management lets it work with customers during process development; consumables create recurring demand.
en.risks: Semiconductor output and capital cycles, customer concentration, raw-material constraints and export controls affect results; acquisition debt and integration add pressure.
en.competition: Entegris names competitors by segment. Pall, part of Danaher, is an Advanced Purity Solutions peer; Merck KGaA EMD Performance Materials is a Materials Solutions peer. Merck KGaA is distinct from US Merck & Co. Filtration, materials and handling portfolios are not interchangeable across all products.
en.relationships: Supplies materials, filters and delivery components to wafer fabs and equipment makers, supporting contamination control in volume production. TSMC represented 16% of FY2025 sales, according to company disclosure. This identifies a customer for semiconductor materials and contamination-control products, without a complete customer-specific product split or minimum future orders.

en.business: Builds semiconductor wafer-cleaning equipment and is expanding into electroplating, furnace and packaging-process tools, with operations centered on its China subsidiary.
en.revenue: Earns from equipment sales to chipmakers and post-installation parts and service; cleaning remains the core while the process portfolio expands.
en.strength: Combines proprietary multi-wafer cleaning technology with engineering and support close to Chinese customers, and can extend into adjacent process steps.
en.risks: Revenue and assets are heavily concentrated in China, exposing the company to U.S.-China rules, audit and listing issues and export controls; customer concentration and tool qualification also matter.
en.competition: ACM names Lam Research, SCREEN and Kokusai Semiconductor Equipment among rivals across cleaning, plating and furnace equipment, and Applied Materials in PECVD. These are distinct process-tool categories rather than interchangeable products.
en.relationships: Primarily supplies cleaning, plating and thermal-process tools to Chinese fabs and purchases precision components and materials from suppliers.

ja.strength: 顧客装置に合わせた設計、厳しい清浄度管理、精密溶接と量産対応を一体で提供する。認定に時間がかかるため継続採用されやすい。
ja.risks: 売上が少数の装置メーカーに大きく集中し、その生産計画と半導体設備投資に左右される。品質問題や部品不足も影響が大きい。

ja.relationships: 半導体装置メーカーへ組み込まれる流体システムと部品を供給し、精密加工・材料の仕入先から部材を調達する。 FY2025の自社年次報告書はLam Research、Applied Materials、ASMLを主要OEM顧客として明記。流体供給システムや精密部品の関係で、将来の最低発注数量を保証するものではない。

en.business: Makes gas-and-chemical delivery subsystems, ultra-high-purity weldments and precision components built into semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
en.revenue: Sells engineered fluid-delivery subsystems, components and precision-machined products to major semiconductor equipment makers.
en.strength: Combines customer-specific design, stringent purity control, precision welding and volume manufacturing; lengthy qualification can support recurring programs.
en.risks: Revenue is highly concentrated among a few equipment customers and follows their production plans and semiconductor capital spending; quality issues and component shortages can have outsized effects.
en.competition: Examples include Ultra Clean in fluid-delivery subsystems and Benchmark Electronics in semiconductor-equipment precision machining. Ichor explicitly names Ultra Clean; Benchmark is an editorial comparison of disclosed machining services. Fluid delivery and machining are distinct scopes.
en.relationships: Supplies fluid systems and components integrated into wafer-fab equipment and sources materials and precision parts from its supplier base. Its FY2025 annual report names Lam Research, Applied Materials and ASML as major OEM customers for fluid-delivery systems and precision components. This does not guarantee minimum future order volumes.

en.business: Builds complex subsystems and components for semiconductor equipment and provides ultra-high-purity cleaning and analysis for used parts.

en.relationships: Supplies assembled subsystems to equipment manufacturers and receives parts from equipment companies and fabs for cleaning and analysis. ja.business: 電波の送受信に使うRF・アナログ半導体を作る会社。2026年10月5日にQorvoとの統合を完了し、車載・産業・防衛などへ製品範囲を広げた。
ja.revenue: 端末メーカーや通信・車載・産業機器会社へ、RFフロントエンド、増幅器、フィルター、接続用チップを販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 複数の無線部品を小型モジュールへまとめる設計力と製造技術、端末メーカーでの長い認定実績が強み。
ja.risks: スマートフォンと大口顧客への依存が大きく、機種変更や販売不振が直撃する。価格競争、在庫調整、中国需要、製造歩留まりも影響する。Qorvo事業の統合負担や買収資金の負債も確認が必要。
ja.competition: 携帯・Wi-Fi向けのRFモジュールやフィルターではBroadcom、Qualcomm、村田製作所が競合例。統合前の実名開示と公式製品を照合した。Qorvoとは2026年10月5日に統合を完了しており、現在の独立した競合としては扱わない。
ja.relationships: スマートフォン、通信機器、自動車、産業機器メーカーへ無線・アナログ部品を供給し、外部の製造・組立会社も利用する。 FY2025の自社開示ではApple向けが売上の67%。代理店・製造受託会社を経由する販売と直接販売の合計で、Appleへの直接請求だけの比率ではない。2025年10月3日期の統合前Skyworksの数値であり、Qorvo統合後の現在の合算売上比率に置き換えない。

en.revenue: Sells RF front-end modules, amplifiers, filters and connectivity chips to device, communications, automotive and industrial manufacturers.
en.strength: Combines multiple radio functions in compact modules, backed by manufacturing know-how and long qualification histories with device makers.
en.risks: Heavy smartphone and major-customer exposure makes model changes and weak sell-through important; pricing, inventory corrections, China demand and manufacturing yields also matter. Qorvo integration and acquisition financing add execution and debt risks.
en.competition: Broadcom, Qualcomm and Murata are examples in mobile/Wi-Fi RF modules and filters, checked against pre-combination named disclosures and official products. The Qorvo combination closed on October 5, 2026; Qorvo is no longer presented as an independent rival.
en.relationships: Supplies wireless and analog components to smartphone, network, automotive and industrial manufacturers and also uses external manufacturing and assembly providers. Its FY2025 filing attributes 67% of revenue to Apple, combining distributor, contract-manufacturer and direct sales. This is not a direct-billing-only share. The figure covers pre-combination Skyworks for the year ended October 3, 2025, rather than the current combined Skyworks/Qorvo business.

ja.business: 光通信、データセンター、通信、防衛で使う高周波・アナログ半導体を作る会社。RF、マイクロ波、光部品を扱う。
ja.revenue: 通信・クラウド機器、防衛、産業機器メーカーへ、増幅器、レーザー・光検出器、ダイオード、GaN製品を販売して稼ぐ。

ja.risks: 通信・データセンター投資の波、輸出規制、顧客と製品の集中、外部工場の供給、買収統合、防衛案件の時期が業績を動かす。
ja.competition: MACOM自身はAnalog Devices・Broadcom・Marvell・Skyworksなどを競合に挙げる。比較分野はRF・マイクロ波・光通信用の高性能アナログ半導体で、全社の全製品が同等ではない。旧Qorvoは2026年10月5日にSkyworksとの統合が完了しており、現行の独立上場競合として重複表示しない。顧客の内製設計も代替になる。
ja.relationships: データセンター・通信機器会社と防衛・産業顧客へ半導体を供給し、外部工場や組立会社へ製造を委託する。 2026年2月、SemtechとACC-MSAの共同議長を務め、リニア・イコライザーを使う銅接続の電気・ファームウェア・試験仕様の策定を発表。規格協力であり、加盟全社との個別売買や出資を意味しない。

en.business: Makes high-frequency and analog semiconductors for optical networking, data centers, telecom, defense and industrial systems across RF, microwave and photonics.
en.revenue: Sells amplifiers, lasers and photodetectors, diodes and GaN products to communications, cloud-equipment, defense and industrial manufacturers.
en.strength: Spans high-speed optical and RF technologies and can apply compound semiconductors, silicon and photonics to different performance needs.
en.risks: Communications and data-center spending cycles, export controls, customer and product concentration, foundry supply, acquisition integration and defense-program timing affect results.
en.competition: MACOM names Analog Devices, Broadcom, Marvell and Skyworks among its competitors in RF, microwave and photonic analog semiconductors. Entire portfolios are not equivalent. Qorvo completed its combination with Skyworks on October 5, 2026 and is not duplicated as a currently independent listed peer. Customer in-house design remains an alternative.
en.relationships: Supplies chips to data-center and communications-equipment makers and defense and industrial customers, while outsourcing portions of fabrication and assembly. In February 2026 MACOM and Semtech announced co-chairing ACC-MSA to define electrical, firmware and test specifications for copper interconnects with linear equalizers. Standards work does not establish purchases or investments between every consortium member.
