ja.business: 電力変換用のモジュール部品と電源システムを作る会社。
ja.revenue: 電源製品の販売と、顧客とのライセンス契約による特許料で稼ぐ。製品はAdvanced ProductsとBrick Productsに分かれる。
ja.strength: 独自の半導体回路などで性能に差をつけた製品を持つ。Factorized Power Architectureが特徴。
ja.risks: 業績は四半期ごとに変動しやすい。少数の大口顧客と少数の供給元の動向に左右される。

en.business: A company that makes modular power components and power systems for converting electrical power.
en.revenue: It earns by selling power products and from royalties on licensing arrangements with customers. Products fall into Advanced Products and Brick Products.
en.strength: Its products stand out on performance, built on proprietary semiconductor circuitry. Its Factorized Power Architecture is a distinctive feature.
en.risks: Results swing from quarter to quarter. It depends on a few large customers and a few suppliers.

sources.label: Valmont Form 10-K (filed 2026-02-24) · Business / Competition / Risk factors

ja.business: 電力・通信・照明の支柱と農業用灌漑設備を作る会社。
ja.revenue: インフラ部門と農業部門の2本柱。送電用構造物、照明・交通用ポール、通信設備、灌漑装置を売って稼ぐ。
ja.strength: ガルバナイズなどの塗装サービスまで自社で手がける。品質と技術力、納期の正確さで競う。
ja.risks: 顧客業界は景気の波が大きく、過去に売上が落ちた。弱い需要期には価格競争が激しくなる。

en.business: A maker of utility, lighting and telecom structures and irrigation equipment.
en.revenue: Its two segments are Infrastructure and Agriculture. It earns from transmission structures, poles, telecom gear and irrigation systems.
en.strength: It also offers coatings such as galvanizing in-house. It competes on quality, engineering expertise and on-time delivery.
en.risks: Its customer industries are highly cyclical, and downturns have cut sales before. Price competition gets intense when demand is weak.

sources.label: Wesco Form 10-K (filed 2026-02-13) · Business / Competition / Risk factors

ja.business: 電気・通信資材などを企業に卸す、物流込みの流通会社。
ja.revenue: 電気・電子、通信・セキュリティ、公益・ブロードバンドの3部門で稼ぐ。顧客は産業、通信、公益事業など。
ja.strength: 数百万点の商品と一貫した供給網サービス、デジタル力を備える。データセンター向けにも強い。
ja.risks: 市場は細分化され、各分野で競争が激しい。世界経済の悪化や金融市場の混乱にも弱い。

en.business: A business-to-business distributor of electrical and communications supplies with logistics services.
en.revenue: It earns from three segments: Electrical & Electronic, Communications & Security, and Utility & Broadband. Customers span industry, telecom and utilities.
en.strength: Millions of products, end-to-end supply chain services and digital capabilities. It is also a leader in data center solutions.
en.risks: Its markets are fragmented and highly competitive. A weak global economy or financial market disruption can hurt it.

sources.label: Advanced Drainage Systems Form 10-K (filed 2026-05-21) · Business / Competition / Risk factors

ja.business: 雨水排水や浄化槽向けの排水製品を作る水管理の会社。
ja.revenue: 住宅、非住宅、インフラ、農業向けに排水管や汚水処理製品を売って稼ぐ。全国の販売網を通す。
ja.strength: 全国をカバーする販売網と幅広い品ぞろえが特徴。雨が地面に落ちてから戻るまでの水を一貫して扱う。
ja.risks: 業績は景気に左右されやすい。金利や新築住宅の需要、道路などインフラ支出の影響を受ける。

en.business: A company that makes drainage products for stormwater and onsite wastewater.
en.revenue: It earns by selling drainage pipe and wastewater products for residential, non-residential, infrastructure and agriculture uses, through a national distribution platform.
en.strength: Its national sales network and broad product line stand out, covering water from the moment rain hits the ground until it returns to the ecosystem.
en.risks: Results are cyclical and follow the economy, including interest rates, new home demand and infrastructure spending.

sources.label: Watsco Form 10-K (filed 2026-02-27) · Business / Competition / Risk factors

ja.business: 空調・暖房・冷凍機器と部品を販売する北米最大の卸売会社。
ja.revenue: 2025年のHVAC/R流通の売上は7.2 billionドル。695拠点から、13万超の施工業者に売る。
ja.strength: 買収した企業を伸ばす「buy and build」の戦略が特徴。北米で最大の流通網を持つ。
ja.risks: 仕入先が集中している。上位10社が購入の85%、Carrierだけで62%を占める。

en.business: The largest North American distributor of air conditioning, heating and refrigeration equipment and parts.
en.revenue: HVAC/R distribution revenue reached $7.2 billion in 2025, sold from 695 locations to more than 130,000 active contractors.
en.strength: Its buy and build strategy of acquiring market leaders and growing them is a hallmark, and it has the largest distribution network in the industry.
en.risks: Suppliers are concentrated: the top ten made up 85% of purchases in 2025, with Carrier alone at 62%.

ja.business: ビルや住宅向けの水まわり製品とソリューションをつくる会社。
ja.revenue: 米州、欧州、アジア太平洋・中東・アフリカの3地域で、商業用と住宅用の水関連製品を売って稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 安全と規制、省エネ、節水の3テーマが軸。スマート水管理のNexaなど、デジタル分野にも投資する。
ja.risks: 商業・住宅の着工や改修の景気循環に業績が左右される。取引先の資金繰り悪化も響く。

en.business: A manufacturer of water technologies and solutions for commercial and residential buildings.
en.revenue: It sells water-related products for commercial and residential buildings in three regions: the Americas, Europe, and APMEA.
en.strength: Its focus is safety and regulation, energy efficiency and water conservation, and it invests in digital tools like Nexa.
en.risks: Results swing with economic cycles in building starts and remodeling, and customers' financial trouble can also hit it.

ja.business: 北米と欧州で貨物輸送サービスを提供する会社。
ja.revenue: 北米の小口貨物(LTL)輸送と欧州の輸送の2部門で稼ぐ。北米LTLが最大。
ja.strength: 自社開発の技術とAI、トレーラー工場、運転手養成校が競争上の強み。
ja.risks: 景気後退で貨物量が減ると業績に響く。輸送業界は競争が激しい。

en.business: A company that provides freight transportation in North America and Europe.
en.revenue: It earns through two segments: North American less-than-truckload (LTL), the largest, and European Transportation.
en.strength: Its edges are proprietary technology and AI, a trailer plant and truck driver schools.
en.risks: A recession that cuts freight volumes hurts results. The transport market is highly competitive.
en.competition: Main competitors include Old Dominion Freight Line, Saia.
